application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

units_released.note: Rule: distinct vehicles among vehicle files. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2024.100356, Sec. 3.1 and Appendix A Table 1: VW ID.3 108s2p NMC pouch (216 cells), Tesla Model 3 SR+ 106s1p LFP (106 cells); vehicles counted: Tesla Model 3 SR+, VW ID.3

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Cell-voltage columns per vehicle: Tesla Model 3 SR+ 106, VW ID.3 108.

span_unit_years.note: First to last measurement date per vehicle (VW ID.3 2021-02-05 to 2024-04-24); Tesla files carry no timestamps and are left out. This is the calendar span between discrete charge tests, not continuous telemetry. Paper Table 2 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2024.100356, p. 12) dates the measurements 2021-02-08 to 2024-05-22; the 2024 file is the paper's ID.Software 3.2 charge (59.44 kWh charged in the data, 59.40 kWh in Sec. 4.5) but is dated 2024-04-22 to 04-24 in the data.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://mediatum.ub.tum.de/1737452; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
